Operators cannot attach a default flow to a connection through the live UI. Backend endpoints work (verified via tests). Either add a route/tab that mounts WhatsAppConnectionsPage, or port the GitBranch modal into the inline ConexoesPage's connection cards.

action_items: Wire WhatsAppConnectionsPage.js into the routing (or move the GitBranch + default-flow modal into the inline ConexoesPage in Dashboard.js) so operators can attach a default flow to a WhatsApp connection from the live UI. Backend endpoints (POST/PUT /api/channels/connections with default_flow_id) are functioning correctly.
Minor: TestF3ConnectionFlowId.test_connection_create_with_default_flow_id_preserved emits a PytestReturnNotNoneWarning — the test returns a tuple at the end. Cosmetic only; tests still pass.
critical_code_review_comments: _user_can_view_all_tickets correctly handles role super_admin/company_admin and the explicit 'view_all_tickets' permission. Filter combines with $search via $and to avoid clobbering an existing $or — clean implementation.
claim_ticket is properly idempotent for the owner (re-claim returns 200) and 409 for foreign non-admin claimants. release_ticket allows owner OR admin (correct).

_trigger_flow_for_ticket node entry-point selection is reasonable (start/trigger/message/welcome → fallback to first node with text). Welcome is persisted to ticket.messages with auto_flow_id, and active_flow_id+flow_started_at are set. Microservice POST is best-effort with try/except (expected to fail in preview env per spec).
preview-pdf-html shares the same _QUOTE_STYLESHEET as the PDF generator — perfect for visual parity between iframe preview and download.

POST /kanban-columns/reorder correctly drops native:* ids from the input (anchored left) and bulk-updates `order` 1-indexed. GET /kanban-v2 prepends NATIVE_FIRST_COLUMN unconditionally so native is always left-most.

Channels webhook /webhook/message has a heuristic _looks_like_lid that treats 14+ digit phones starting outside (55, 12-13 digits) as LID-like and merges them into recent tickets — testers must use 13-digit Brazilian phones (5511 + 9 + 8 digits) to avoid spurious merges. (Not a code bug, but a testing gotcha — fixed in the test fixture.)

FRONTEND ROUTING GAP: WhatsAppConnectionsPage.js is imported but never rendered on the active 'Conexoes' sidebar tab. The inline ConexoesPage in /pages/Company/Dashboard.js (~line 3021) has its own connection card grid without the GitBranch + default-flow modal. F3 UI surface is incomplete on the live route.

rca of the issue: F3 frontend integration partial-failure RCA: WhatsAppConnectionsPage.js carries the new default_flow_id UI (GitBranch edit-conn-{id} button → modal with conn-default-flow-select + save-conn-btn). It IS imported in /pages/Company/Dashboard.js (line 21) but the actual 'Conexoes' menu item resolves to the inline ConexoesPage component (Dashboard.js ~3021) which renders its own connection cards without a GitBranch button — therefore data-testid='edit-conn-*' resolves to 0 elements on the live route.
